rows.description: At night the shadows look like monsters and my heart beats fast. The fear is real to me. Wise parents do not laugh, use a night light and a hug and calm words. Saying "there is nothing" does not help as much as staying.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, mockery, trust
related mind states: amusement, affection, fear, calm

rows.description: I run to my parent after thunder and they hold me and say "I am here". I feel calm. Being comforted does not make children weaker; it teaches them to calm themselves later.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, mockery
related mind states: calm, trust

rows.description: I am scared of the first day at a new class or the dog next door. My tummy hurts and I cling. A wise adult says "it is okay to be scared, we will go slowly", and gives me a small brave step.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, mockery, trust
related mind states: fear, hurt

rows.description: My friend holds my hand during the scary part of the movie. I feel less alone. Someone else's kindness in fear teaches me to do the same for others one day.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: fear, mockery, trust
related mind states: fear, empathy

rows.description: My parent laughs and says "don't be a baby, there is nothing there". I feel ashamed and hide my fear. Being mocked for fear teaches me to keep quiet. Being believed helps the fear grow smaller.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, trust
related mind states: amusement, fear, shame

rows.description: I made a tower all by myself and shout "look at me!" I feel tall and happy. Wise adults look and say what they see, "you worked hard on it". Proud feelings drive me to try more.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, rivalry
related mind states: joy, pride

rows.description: Mummy sees my drawing and says she loves it. I feel a warm glow. Pride shared with a parent makes it bigger. Wise parents notice effort and detail, not just say "good" every time.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, rivalry
related mind states: affection, pride

rows.description: I show my badge to a friend and he looks away sadly. I feel confused. A wise child says "you can get one too" and asks about his own work. Sharing pride without bragging keeps friendships warm.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: pride, rivalry
related mind states: sadness, confusion, pride, envy

rows.description: I show my work and my sister says "mine is better". I feel smaller. Wise parents praise each child for their own effort and do not turn pride into a contest.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, pride
related mind states: pride

rows.description: I wet my pants in class and want to vanish. My face burns and I cry. A wise teacher helps quietly, gets a change and does not draw attention. It is an accident, not a failure, and I am not alone in this.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, humiliation, mockery
related mind states: sadness, shame
